Community

Find your people

Members meet in groups built around the parts of work and life they care about most.

Overview

Her Circle is small on purpose. Groups stay at a size where people know each other’s names, follow up and actually help.

Community groups

  • Career

    Promotions, negotiation, career changes and navigating the workplace.

  • Business

    For founders and owners: sourcing, distribution, hiring, financing and growth.

  • Wellness

    Mental health, rest and caring for yourself while caring for others.

  • Personal Growth

    Reading, reflection and honest conversations about identity and ambition.

  • Social

    Dinners, outings and friendships outside of work.
